name: hud_layout_hw_disable
description: HudLayoutHW::Disable dispatches the layout SetEnabled slot with enabled=0.
known_limits: Tier C first; no VC verification target currently covers 0x4135f0, so tier S acceptance remains deferred to a HUD layout source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation for 0x4135f0 validate loading self->base.ftable, pushing 0, dispatching ftable slot offset +4, and returning.
The indirect slot is the same HudLayoutBase/HudLayoutHW SetEnabled boundary used by the accepted Enable path, with no direct callees or additional state changes.
The native hardware layout disable smoke installs a custom ftable slot 1 capture, calls Disable, and verifies the dispatch receives this == layout and enabled == 0.
